form.label: L2T - NTFS and File System
form.description: Comprehensive NTFS $MFT and file system analysis for digital forensics and incident response

search.query: index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | stats count by hostname | sort hostname
index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | stats count by timestamp_desc | sort timestamp_desc

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval filepath=coalesce(display_name, filename) | stats dc(filepath)

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | search (macb="*B*" OR message="*CREATE*" OR message="*BORN*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | search (message="*USN_REASON*" OR source_long="*USN*") | stats count

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval filepath=coalesce(display_name, filename) | rex field=filepath "\.(?<extension>[^.\\\/]+)$" | eval extension=if(isnull(extension), "No Ext", upper(extension)) | rex field=message "File reference: (?<file_ref>[0-9\-]+)" | rex field=message "USN_REASON_(?<usn_reason>[A-Z_]+)" | eval activity_risk=case( like(filepath, "*\\Temp\\*") AND like(message, "*CREATE*"), "High", like(filepath, "*\\System32\\*") AND like(macb, "*M*"), "High", like(filepath, "*\\Startup\\*"), "Medium", like(filepath, "*.exe") AND like(message, "*CREATE*"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | eval macb_desc=case( macb=="M...", "Modified", macb==".A..", "Accessed", macb=="..C.", "Changed", macb=="...B", "Created", macb=="MA..", "Mod+Access", macb=="MAC.", "Full (MAC)", macb=="MACB", "Complete", true(), macb ) | table datetime, hostname, sourcetype, macb_desc, extension, filepath, timestamp_desc, file_ref, usn_reason, activity_risk | sort activity_risk

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval activity_type=case( like(macb, "%M%") OR like(message, "*MODIFY*"), "Modified", like(macb, "%A%") OR like(message, "*ACCESS*"), "Accessed", like(macb, "%C%") OR like(message, "*CHANGE*"), "Changed", like(macb, "%B%") OR like(message, "*CREATE*"), "Created", like(message, "*DELETE*") OR like(message, "*REMOVE*"), "Deleted", true(), "Other" ) | timechart span=1h count by activity_type

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval macb_clean=if(macb="", "Unknown", macb) | eval macb_description=case( macb_clean=="M...", "Modified Only", macb_clean==".A..", "Accessed Only", macb_clean=="..C.", "Changed Only", macb_clean=="...B", "Created Only", macb_clean=="MA..", "Modified + Accessed", macb_clean=="MAC.", "Modified + Accessed + Changed", macb_clean=="MACB", "Full Timeline", true(), macb_clean ) | stats count by macb_description | sort -count

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | search message="*USN_REASON*" | rex field=message "USN_REASON_(?<usn_reason>[A-Z_]+)" | stats count by usn_reason | sort -count | head 10

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | rex field=message "File reference: (?<file_ref>[0-9\-]+)" | rex field=message "Parent file reference: (?<parent_ref>[0-9\-]+)" | where isnotnull(file_ref) | stats count, values(macb) as activities, values(timestamp_desc) as timestamp_types, earliest(_time) as first_activity, latest(_time) as last_activity by file_ref, parent_ref, hostname | eval first_activity=strftime(first_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_activity=strftime(last_activity, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count | head 15

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval filepath=coalesce(display_name, filename) | eval suspicious_indicator=case( like(filepath, "*\\Temp\\*") AND like(message, "*CREATE*"), "Temp File Creation", like(filepath, "*\\Windows\\System32\\*") AND like(macb, "*M*"), "System File Modified", like(filepath, "*\\Startup\\*") OR like(filepath, "*\\Start Menu\\*"), "Startup Persistence", like(filepath, "*\\Downloads\\*") AND (like(filepath, "*.exe") OR like(filepath, "*.bat")), "Downloaded Executable", like(filepath, "*Recycle*") OR like(filepath, "*$Recycle*"), "Recycle Bin Activity", like(message, "*DELETE*") AND like(filepath, "*\\Windows\\System32\\*"), "System File Deletion", like(filepath, "*\\.dat") AND like(filepath, "*\\Users\\*\\AppData\\*"), "Hidden Data File", like(message, "*RENAME*") AND like(filepath, "*.exe"), "Executable Renamed", true(), "Normal" ) | where suspicious_indicator!="Normal" | stats count, values(macb) as activities, values(timestamp_desc) as timestamp_types, earliest(_time) as first_seen, latest(_time) as last_seen by suspicious_indicator, filepath, hostname | eval first_seen=strftime(first_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | eval last_seen=strftime(last_seen, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort -count

format.colorPalette: {"Temp File Creation":#F58F39,"System File Modified":#DC4E41,"Startup Persistence":#D93F3C,"Downloaded Executable":#F58F39,"Recycle Bin Activity":#F8BE34,"System File Deletion":#DC4E41,"Hidden Data File":#F8BE34,"Executable Renamed":#F58F39}

search.query: index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | search (macb="*B*" OR message="*CREATE*" OR message="*USN_REASON_FILE_CREATE*") | eval filepath=coalesce(display_name, filename) | rex field=filepath "\.(?<extension>[^.\\\/]+)$" | eval extension=if(isnull(extension), "No Extension", upper(extension)) | eval risk_level=case( match(extension, "(?i)(exe|bat|cmd|scr|com|pif)"), "High", match(extension, "(?i)(dll|sys|ini)"), "Medium", match(extension, "(?i)(tmp|temp)"), "Medium", true(), "Low" ) | stats count by filepath, extension, risk_level, hostname, datetime | sort risk_level | head 20

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval filepath=coalesce(display_name, filename) | rex field=filepath "^(?<directory>.*[\\\/])[^\\\/]*$" | where isnotnull(directory) AND directory!="" | stats count by directory | sort -count | head 12

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | eval filepath=coalesce(display_name, filename) | rex field=filepath "\.(?<extension>[^.\\\/]+)$" | where isnotnull(extension) AND extension!="" | eval extension=lower(extension) | stats count by extension | sort -count | head 15

index=host sourcetype IN ("l2t:File", "l2t:NTFS") | search hostname=$hostFilter$ sourcetype=$sourcetypeFilter$ macb=$macbFilter$ timestamp_desc=$timestampFilter$ | search (display_name="*$fileFilter$*" OR filename="*$fileFilter$*") | search (message="*$contentSearch$*" OR description="*$contentSearch$*") | stats count by timestamp_desc | sort -count | head 10
